tha-ap498:2.2: ghatamaṇḍamupānayiṁ → ghatamaṇḍaṁ upānayiṁ (bj, sya-all) | upānayiṁ → ghatamaṇḍamupānayiṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap498:2.3: ācitattā → upacitattā (sya-all) | ca → upacittāca (bj: syā) | ācitattā → upacitattā (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap498:2.4: gaṅgā bhāgīrathī → gaṅgābhāgīrasī (sya-all) | bhāgīrathī → bhāgīrasī (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap498:3.3: ayañca pathavī → ayaṁ ca paṭhavī (bj) | pathavī → paṭhavī (sya-all)
tha-ap498:4.2: madhusakkarā cātuddīpā → madhusakkharā cātuddipā (bj) | bhavate madhusakkarā cātuddīpā → bhavanti te madhusakkharā catuddisā (sya-all) | madhusakkharā → madhusakkarā (bj: machasaṁ) | madhusakkarā → madhusakkharā (cck: syā. ka.)
tha-ap498:7.1: catunnavutito → channavute ito (bj) | ito → catunnavutito (bj: machasaṁ) | Catunnavutito → chanavute ito (cck: sī.)
